elements.notes:
¹ Production data are in kilograms, rhenium content.
² Includes metal powder.
³ Ammonium perrhenate is a chemical compound containing rhenium.
⁴ Apparent consumption = production + imports - exports.
⁵ Price data are average values per kilogram gross weight.
⁶ Net import reliance = (imports - exports) / apparent consumption * 100.
